name: Bred For War
body:
Your familiarity with martial weapons is matched only by your thirst for conquest.

Prerequisite(s): Thaun

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 racial bonus on damage rolls with martial (not simple or exotic) melee weapons while in combat.
